question: Who is the author of the book Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India’s Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief of Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi launched the book *Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India’s Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan* written by Retd. Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book was authored by Retd. Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion.**
 
• **The book narrates the story of India’s deep strikes inside Pakistan during Operation Sindoor.**
 
• **General Upendra Dwivedi praised the book as a tribute to the Indian Army's courage and professionalism.**
 
• **The book is recommended for academia and research scholars as a reference material.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• General Upendra Dwivedi__ - The Chief of the Army Staff of India, who launched the book.
 
• __Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion__ - A retired Lieutenant General of the Indian Army and the author of the book.
 
• __Operation Sindoor__ - A military operation by the Indian Army involving deep strikes inside Pakistan.
